name: creafico - Competitor intelligence app for short-form creators.
tagline: Every short-form creator knows the formula: study what works, make your version, post consistently
description: Every short-form creator knows the formula: study what works, make your version, post consistently. So, creators open Instagram or TikTok to find ideas, lose 45 minutes doomscrolling, and close the app with zero usable ideas. They turn to ChatGPT or Claude and get generic suggestions like "Top 10 Sunset Video Ideas" with no proof they actually work. creafico fixes this. Pick up to 20 competitor accounts in your niche. creafico continuously scans their accounts and detects viral videos instantly.
